title: kiro fetch_user_activity_report
description: A pointer to one day's Kiro user-activity CSV report for one client type, copied into the runner's blob store. The payload never carries the CSV bytes.

s3_bucket.description: The blob store bucket holding the copy. Absent when the store cannot name itself, such as a memory or directory store; s3_key then locates the copy in the runner's configured store.

s3_key.description: The copy's key: kiro/<organization>/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/<client type>_user_report.csv. A re-fetch overwrites the same key.

source_bucket.description: The customer's bucket the vendor wrote the report into.

source_key.description: The report's key in the customer's bucket, ending <client type>_<account>_user_report_<timestamp>.csv.

content_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the stored bytes.

source_last_modified.description: The source object's LastModified in UTC, RFC 3339, to the second.
